en: Vintage postcard with a monochrome illustration of a narrow European street lined with historic gabled brick buildings. In the distance is a small tower or belfry-like structure with a dome. The drawing is placed on the left side of the card, leaving a large blank area on the right for writing. At the top center, decorative text reads 'BRUGES'. Below the image, curved text identifies the scene as a specific street. Along the left margin of the illustration there is a small vertical publisher credit.
